title: ErrorResponse
description:
Uniform error envelope for every non-2xx response produced by GlucoTwin,
including FastAPI/Pydantic validation failures, which are translated into this
shape. `detail` is a JSON object (never a bare string or array) and never
contains participant-level physiological values or stack traces.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Clients may branch on this.

detail.description: Structured context for debugging and UI display. May be empty.
